description: Create, list or revoke links that let other people view a saved map or join it as editors, change a link's role, or list and manage the people who joined.

label.description: Who the link is for. create with the same label and role returns the same link.

link_id.description: Required for revoke/set_role: link_id returned by map_share list.

member_id.description: Required for remove_member/set_member_role: member_id from list_members.

role.description: Required for set_role and set_member_role; optional for create (default viewer). viewer can look; editor invites people to edit once they sign in.

name: map_share
title: Share map
